slogantodo.title: SloganTodo - Protected Task Management Application
slogantodo.desc: A modern Angular 17 task management web application implementing secure JWT authentication and protected routing via Auth Guards. Optimized for maximum performance using feature-based Lazy Loading and Standalone Components. Built with a responsive UI utilizing PrimeNG, Angular Material, and Bootstrap 5, powered by RxJS for reactive state handling.

slogansocial.title: SloganSocial - Gmail Email Sequencer & Analytics Platform
slogansocial.desc: An advanced Gmail Sequencer frontend application built with Angular 17, designed to help users automate and sequence email marketing campaigns. Features integrated analytics dashboards powered by Chart.js to track user engagement. Built with a professional UI combining Material Design, PrimeNG, and Bootstrap, utilizing ngx-cookie-service for secure session management.

helloflow.title: HelloFlow - Social Media Marketing Automation Platform
helloflow.desc: Developed a comprehensive Angular 17-based web application for managing multi-account social media campaigns. Implemented secure user authentication with JWT token management, email verification, and password recovery. Built modular campaign management system with CRUD operations including draft/active/completed campaign tracking. Integrated cookie-based session persistence using ngx-cookie-service and implemented account credit management system. Architecture features standalone components, RxJS observables for reactive data flows, and responsive UI with PrimeNG components.

sigma.title: SiGma - Enterprise-Grade Web Application
sigma.desc: An enterprise-grade Angular v17 web application with modular architecture, feature-based lazy loading, and reactive state management using RxJS BehaviorSubjects. Features robust authentication with HTTP interceptors, global error handling, and multi-language support (ngx-translate). Built with professional UI using Metronic and Bootstrap 5, incorporating advanced DataTables, Leaflet maps, and multi-domain integration (Billing, HR, Lease, Fleet Management).
